thread:
daria: FYI — BlueJar (OrbitEdge) RFP came back with a technical addendum. They need a capability matrix, a short data flow sketch, and a 30-day POC window. Key asks: customer-managed KMS/HSM, on-prem bundle, per-token pricing tier for sustained QPS, and a security questionnaire attached (link). Can we stand this up next week?

sam: I can take POC infra and perf baseline. Need expected max concurrent requests and which model family they want to evaluate (LLM size / family). @oliver can you draft capability rows for quantization, KV cache, and fallback behavior?

oliver: Yep — I'll add rows for: model variants supported, quantization profiles (8-bit/4-bit), latency SLOs at 512/1024 tokens, KV cache & prefix caching, supported instance types, and automatic fallback policies. Draft by EOD.

maria: Started the security questionnaire. A few blockers I flagged: do we support importing keys into customer HSMs for Private? What's our default encryption for Dedicated (KMS provider + key rotation cadence)? Also need SOC2/ISO cert copies and retention/backup SLAs. I'll inline comments on the doc.

daria: Legal also called out a "no-exfiltration" clause — can we confirm network egress controls for VPC/private deployments? Alex from eng-infra, can you confirm network and peering constraints?

alex: VPC peering + strict routing + customer-managed NAT will satisfy the "no-exfiltration" ask if buyer provides routing. For HSM: Private supports BYO-HSM via our provisioning script but requires a short maintenance window. I'll paste the runbook snippet below and attach the script to the drive link.

alex: ```bash
# provision customer HSM key (example)
redwoodctl private create-kms --type=hsm --key-id=projects/bluejar/keys/edge-01 --region=us-east1 --import-token-file=./hsm-token.bin
```

sam: For the POC infra plan I'd recommend Hosted for quick onboarding + a small Dedicated pool as a backstop for load tests. Tentative perf-cost calc: ~$2.5k/day at peak test capacity (rough). I'll refine once I have concurrent req numbers.

daria: POC scheduling — buyer asked for a 30-day eval but wants the onboarding week next Mon/Wed. Proposed windows: onboarding Mon (day 0) -> 2 weeks steady-state -> 1-week stress + canary rollouts -> handoff. Can we commit resources week of next Mon? 10am PST quick sync?

oliver: I have a conflict at 10am PST. 11am PST works for me.

sam: 11am PST works.

maria: 11am PST OK. I'll reserve time to go over security Q&A.

daria: Great — locking 11am PST Tuesday. I'll consolidate capability matrix + annotated security answers + runbook into one GDrive folder and send to buyer. Drive links: capability matrix (https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-cap-matrix-BlueJar), sec-ques (https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-sec-q-BlueJar), runbook (https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-runbook-BlueJar).

daria: Items for delivery before sync:
- oliver: capability matrix draft (include explicit row for quantization & fallback)
- sam: POC cost estimate + perf baseline plan
- alex: HSM provisioning script + VPC-peering runbook snippet
- maria: security Q full answers + cert attachments

oliver: On it — I'll ping when draft uploaded. :memo:

sam: I'll add a short cost spreadsheet and a sample perf test plan (k6 scripts).

maria: Uploading SOC2/ISO certs now. Quick note: we should avoid asserting FedRAMP level until legal confirms. Marked that in the questionnaire.

daria: Thanks all — after we finalize I'll produce a single ZIP with the capability matrix, annotated Qs, and the POC ops playbook and share with buyer. :rocket:

alex: FYI: I'll add the small CIDR/peering template they can copy into their network team.

daria: Awesome — closing loop. I'll follow up with meeting invite + links. cc: @sales-lead for visibility.
